title: Facilitator workspace
goal: Cohorts, learner links with consent state, and next-step referrals.
acceptanceCriteria: A facilitator can create a cohort, add a learner only when consent is recorded, and record a referral only for a linked learner.
prototypeBoundaries: In-memory stores reset on process restart.
Demo actor headers are not authentication.
Do not claim live external integrations or real opportunities unless verified.
